sources.title: Model Variants and Checkpoints | ornith-ai/Ornith-1 | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: The Ornith 35B-A3B is a Mixture-of-Experts model that balances the reasoning depth of larger models with the inference speed of smaller ones. It features a sparse architecture where only a fraction of the total parameters (approximately 3B active) are utilized per token, making it ideal for high-throughput agentic applications.
